figures.finding: No film, television or stage agreement or minimum was found for the British Virgin Islands; the only pay floor is the minimum wage, US$7.25 an hour from 1 July 2025, set under the Labour Code, 2010 (S.I. 2025 No. 47).

floor.name: Labour Code (Minimum Basic Wage) Order, 2025 (S.I. 2025 No. 47)

figures.applies: British Virgin Islands (British Overseas Territory), all employees, from 1 July 2025.

sources.said: effective July 1, the new minimum wage in the Territory will be $7.25 per hour. … failure to pay wages at or above the prescribed rate of $7.25 per hour, constitutes an offence under Section 79(1) of the Labour Code, 2010.

Minimum wage with effect from 1 July 2025 … The British Virgin Islands have a government-mandated minimum wage. … Source VIRGIN ISLANDS STATUTORY INSTRUMENT 2025 NO. 47 LABOUR CODE, 2010 (No. 4 of 2010) Labour Code (Minimum Basic Wage) Order, 2025.
